patch: Upgrade Cisco ASA/FTD software to fixed release; enforce multi-factor authentication (MFA).
desc: Unauthorized access and brute-force vulnerability in Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) and Firepower Threat Defense (FTD) SSL-VPN used by Akira for perimeter breach.
yara:
rule Akira_Cisco_Ransomware {
  strings:
    $s1 = "akira"
    $s2 = ".akira"
    $s3 = "powerrun.exe"
  condition:
    any of them
}

patch: Apply SonicOS 7.0.1-5035 / 7.1.1-7040 firmware updates immediately; isolate SSL-VPN interfaces.
desc: Improper access control flaw in SonicWall SonicOS management interface & SSL-VPN leveraged by Akira operators to deploy ransomware binaries.

patch: Install Microsoft Security Bulletin MS17-010; block TCP port 445 on external perimeter.
desc: EternalBlue SMBv1 remote code execution exploit developed by NSA and weaponized globally by threat actors.
yara:
rule WannaCry_EternalBlue {
  strings:
    $ms17 = "SMB_COM_TRANSACTION2"
    $wnry = "WNcry@2ol7"
  condition:
    all of them
}

patch: Deploy Microsoft patch KB2286198; disable automatic shortcut icon extraction across Windows Explorer.
desc: Windows Shell parsing flaw handling .LNK shortcut icons from USB drives without user execution.

patch: Recompile fingerd daemon with bounds checking; disable finger utility across untrusted network nodes.
desc: Exploited fingerd daemon buffer overflow across UNIX systems to self-replicate without credentials.

patch: Downgrade xz-utils to version 5.6.0 or lower; audit upstream release tarballs for injection artifacts.
desc: Supply chain backdoor inserted in liblzma upstream tarball modifying OpenSSH authentication.

patch: Upgrade Apache Log4j to 2.17.1+; set log4j2.formatMsgNoLookups=true in JVM args.
desc: Log4Shell JNDI injection in Apache Log4j parsing logged strings resulting in unauthenticated RCE.
